All 10 assigned items have current Step-1 readiness hashes. Checks passed: precheck and proof layout (five changed items, 18 steps, zero defects), strict contracts (10/10), citation fidelity (46 excerpts), focused dependency and cycle checks, rendering, content policy, and source retrieval. Five sources have fetch stamps; Owen’s source is recorded as dropped after five recovery retries, with local proofs retained. The coverage records the inspected ranges, including [Zhou’s notes](https://zhouquan34.github.io/Sampling/STAT689_Unit1_QuanZhou.pdf) and the [Schön–Lindsten manuscript](https://www.ida.liu.se/divisions/stima/fokurser/smc2025/material/SMC2017.pdf).

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-31.notes.md) record the evidence and remaining run-level holds. Batch 31’s used supplier bodies are present and checked; owner reconciliation is still needed before the run advances.
